# SoundIn

> SoundIn Limited is an independent Scottish software company building calm, accountable systems for Scotland’s night-time economy.

SoundIn builds for the people responsible for venues and live events. Its first product, Holocron, brings the operational record of a night into one place so venue teams, artists, promoters, production teams and security can work from the same information.

## Holocron

Holocron is venue operations software for venues operating under Scottish licensing law. It keeps attendance, incidents, guest lists, ticketing and settlements in one shared record, from briefing to close.

Holocron is designed around the order of a real event rather than the structure of a generic customer relationship management system. Shared records reduce duplicate admin, preserve the context behind decisions and make follow-up work visible after the night ends.

The product is intended for:

- Independent venue operators
- Artists and promoters
- Production teams
- Security teams

Founding access is open until 31 August 2026. Contact SoundIn at https://www.soundin.scot/contact.

## Direct answers

- What is SoundIn? An independent Scottish software company founded by Cougar Macdougall.
- What is Holocron? Venue operations software that keeps the operational record of an event in one place.
- Who is Holocron for? Venues operating under Scottish licensing law, plus the artists, promoters, production teams and security teams they work with.
- Where does SoundIn operate? Scotland.
- How do I contact the founder? Email cougar@soundin.scot.

## Principles

- Calm under pressure: as the room gets louder, the interface should get quieter.
- Accountable by design: important decisions need context, an owner and a record that lasts.
- Built for people on the floor: software should reflect the real order of the night and the limits people work within.
- Focused delivery: SoundIn ships one product at a time.
